Contributing to dimoose

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for helping. Bug reports, keys that fail to import, ideas and pull requests are all welcome.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue at https://github.com/leipzig/dimoose/issues. It helps to include:

  • what you ran, as a small example that can be pasted into R. For a key, the lead table (key$leads) or the spreadsheet rows are usually enough;
  • what you expected and what happened instead, with the full error message;
  • the output of sessionInfo().

For a FishBase key that imports wrongly, give its key number (importFishbase(<number>)).

Please do not post photos or data you are not allowed to share.

Proposing a change

For anything larger than a small fix, open an issue first so we can agree on the approach before you spend time on it.

  1. Fork the repository and make a branch from master.

  2. Install the development dependencies:

    install.packages(c("remotes", "devtools"))
remotes::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)

  3. Make the change, with a test and documentation (see below).

  4. Run the checks:

    devtools::document()   # regenerates man/ and NAMESPACE from the roxygen comments
devtools::test()
devtools::check()

  5. Add a line to the top of NEWS.md saying what changed, in words a user of the package would recognise.

  6. Open a pull request. The checks run on Linux, macOS and Windows (.github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml).

Code style

  • Base R where it is enough; a new dependency needs a good reason. Packages that only one feature needs go in Suggests and are checked for with requireNamespace(), with a message saying what to install.
  • Function and argument names are camelCase (keyFromSpreadsheet(), exportWizard()), to match the existing interface.
  • Call other packages as pkg::fun().
  • Error messages say what is wrong and what to do about it, in plain words, and name the row or lead when there is one ("Row 4 has neitherGoes tonorSpecies"). Use stop(..., call. = FALSE), warning() and message(), not cat() or print(), outside print methods.
  • Comments explain why, not what.

Documentation

Documentation is written as roxygen2 comments with Markdown, above each function in R/. Do not edit man/ or NAMESPACE by hand. Every exported function needs a description of what it returns (@return) and an example that runs without the network or optional software; wrap the ones that cannot in \dontrun{} or use @examplesIf.

The website (https://leipzig.github.io/dimoose/) is built from the repository by .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml; _pkgdown.yml lists the reference sections, so a new exported function has to be added there.

Tests

Tests use testthat (3rd edition) and live in tests/testthat/.

  • Tests must pass with no internet connection and without Python. Logic that handles downloaded data is tested on saved pages or injected data (see test-parse-fishbase.R and fakeVisionModel() in helper-fake-vision.R).

  • A test that really calls a web service starts with skip_on_cran() and skip_if_unreachable(url) (helper-network.R). These are skipped on GitHub Actions, which sets NOT_CRAN=false; run them yourself before changing import code:

    Sys.setenv(NOT_CRAN = "true")
devtools::test(filter = "fishbase|names")

  • A test that needs an optional package starts with skip_if_not_installed().

  • The tests of the real vision model run only when DIMOOSE_CLIP_WEIGHTS points to a weights file (see test-vision-python.R).

The page for people who do not use R

webr/ holds a static page that runs the spreadsheet-to-wizard path in the browser with webR. Build and try it with:

Rscript webr/build.R            # writes webr/_site and checks it on the Montana key
python3 -m http.server --directory webr/_site 8000

The page loads only the R files listed in webr/build.R. If you change keyFromSpreadsheet(), exportWizard() or what they call, run the build again: it fails if those files have come to need code from another file or another package.

Data and photos

Third-party data and photos need a licence that allows redistribution, and an entry in inst/COPYRIGHTS (and in photos.tsv for the Montana photos) giving the source, author and licence.

Conduct

Be kind and assume good faith. Harassment and personal attacks are not accepted in issues, pull requests or any other project space; report problems to the maintainer (address in DESCRIPTION).
